summary_md: **Diego Gomez ([@0xquinto](https://x.com/0xquinto/status/2115471476581130611))** highlights **Knowing When to Stop: The Evidence-Action Gap in Coding Agents**: agents that recognize they are stuck still burn tokens on retries. Per the quoted excerpt, an escalation tool cuts budget exhaustion from 34.0% to 6.7%, and an external monitor (for models that ignore the tool) nearly triples task success.

referenced_urls.title: Knowing When to Stop: The Evidence-Action Gap in Coding Agents
